newsitem.title: USA: KANSAS FED CATTLE TUESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.
newsitem.headline: KANSAS FED CATTLE TUESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow. Few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm. Inquiry moderate to fairly good, demand light. Sales confirmed on 1,900 slaughter steers and 1,400 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 35,200 head confirmed including 28,500 head previously contracted or formulated cattle. Confirmed -
Wk to date - 35,200 last week - 53,000 last year - 15,100

Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 64.00, pen 1250 lb cutting bulls 64.00. Dressed Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1275 lbs 102.00-104.00 hot weights, delivered. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs 64.00; three pens mixed Commercial to Choice 1075-1200 lb heifers and heiferettes 64.00. Dressed Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 104.00 hot weights, delivered.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
